ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a shaded right triangle on the right. Its horizontal base is labeled 30 mm, its left side is vertical, and its top side is slanted down to the right. To the left, there is a dashed right triangle that shares the same vertical height as the shaded triangle. The dashed triangle has a hypotenuse labeled 20 mm and a horizontal leg labeled 12 mm. Right-angle markers indicate both triangles are right triangles. Reasoning: First find the shared vertical height using the dashed right triangle. By the Pythagorean theorem, h = sqrt(20^2 - 12^2) = sqrt(400 - 144) = sqrt(256) = 16 mm. Now use the shaded right triangle, whose legs are 30 mm and 16 mm. Its slanted side is sqrt(30^2 + 16^2) = sqrt(900 + 256) = sqrt(1156) = 34 mm. The perimeter of the shaded triangle is 16 + 30 + 34 = 80 mm.
